annotations.title: LLM Brand Visibility Tracker — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini

description: Find out if ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini recommend your brand. Give it a brand, category and competitors; get back visibility scores and share of voice.

brand_domain.description: Your website domain — used to detect when the AI cites your own site as a source

competitors.description: Competitor names to watch for in the AI's answers (drives share of voice)

number_of_prompts_to_generate.description: How many prompts to auto-generate when none are supplied

openai_api_key.description: Optional — provide your own OpenAI API key to run on your own account (recommended for heavy use)

prompts.description: The buyer-intent questions to test (one per line)

topic_category.description: The category your brand competes in
